B1 adapts mechanisms described in xinchao/src/engine.js, emotion.js, mixed-feelings.js, empathy.js and core-axes.js: drive satisfaction/platforms, segmented resting ceilings, cross-drive modulation, attributed empathy shares, emotion persistence and internal lifecycle. The Python transaction, source-binding, transport and typed presentation code is a GuYan integration/reimplementation; this is not an unchanged copy of the upstream package. Upstream personal relationships, names, private defaults and non-MIT subprojects are not imported. This notice does not claim that the entire upstream repository is MIT licensed.
